title: Why Do Libraries Exist?
hook: A library lets many people share books.
narration: A library lets many people share books.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do Libraries Exist.
You borrow. You return. Someone else learns.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
A library card is a ticket to more brains than one house can hold.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: A library lets many people share books.
The pictures today are a new book world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do libraries exist.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
